select b.oid, b.typarray

SELECT
        id,
        title,
        slug,
        summary AS excerpt,
        content AS body,
        media_type AS "mediaType",
        media_url AS "mediaUrl",
        category,
        source_attribution AS "authorName",
        view_count AS "viewCount",
        published_at AS "publishedAt",
        created_at AS "createdAt"
      FROM agritech_news
      WHERE LOWER(status) = $3
      ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC
      LIMIT $1
      OFFSET $2

SELECT
        sp.id,
        sp.type,
        sp.title,
        sp.caption,
        sp.media_urls,
        sp.like_count,
        sp.relate_count,
        sp.comment_count,
        sp.tags,
        sp.created_at,
        COALESCE(p.username, CONCAT($1, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(u.first_name, $2), $3, $4, $5)))) AS username,
        COALESCE(p.full_name, CONCAT(u.first_name, $6, u.last_name), u.email, $7) AS full_name,
        COALESCE(p.country, $8) AS country,
        COALESCE(p.county_region, u.county, $9) AS county_region,
        p.farming_interests,
        p.crops,
        p.livestock,
        p.years_farming,
        p.certifications,
        p.reputation_score,
        p.followers_count,
        p.avatar_url,
        p.bio,
        p.website,
        p.phone,
        COALESCE(p.email, u.email) AS email,
        p.farming_activities,
        p.farming_photos,
        p.created_at AS profile_created_at
      FROM show_posts sp
      LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = sp.user_id
      LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sp.user_id
      WHERE (sp.status IS NULL OR sp.status IN ($10 /*, ... */))
      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC
      LIMIT $11

SELECT
      tc.table_name,
      kcu.column_name,
      ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
      ccu.column_name AS foreign_column_name,
      rc.update_rule,
      rc.delete_rule
    FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc
    JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu
      ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
      AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
    JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints AS rc
      ON tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
    JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu
      ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
    WHERE tc.constraint_type = $1 AND tc.table_schema = $2
    ORDER BY tc.table_name, kcu.column_name

SELECT p.*, 
               COALESCE(sc.name, pc.name, p.subcategory) AS category_name, 
               sf.name AS field_name, 
               ss.name AS subcategory_name
        FROM products p
        LEFT JOIN shop_fields sf ON p.field_id = sf.id
        LEFT JOIN shop_categories sc ON p.category_id = sc.id
        LEFT JOIN shop_subcategories ss ON p.subcategory_id = ss.id
        LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.id
        WHERE p.status = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.is_featured DESC, p.created_at DESC
        LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements

SELECT
      c.relname as table_name,
      c.reltuples::bigint as estimated_rows,
      pg_size_pretty(pg_table_size(c.oid)) as table_size,
      pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(c.oid)) as index_size,
      pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) as total_size,
      pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) as total_bytes,
      s.n_dead_tup as dead_tuples,
      s.n_live_tup as live_tuples,
      s.last_vacuum,
      s.last_autovacuum,
      s.last_analyze,
      s.last_autoanalyze
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
    WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relkind = $2
    ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC

UPDATE products
    SET 
      description = CASE 
        WHEN description ILIKE $1 OR description ILIKE $2 
        THEN $3
        ELSE description 
      END,
      brand = CASE 
        WHEN brand ILIKE $4 OR brand ILIKE $5
        THEN (CASE WHEN subcategory IS NOT NULL AND subcategory != $6 AND subcategory != $7 THEN subcategory ELSE $8 END)
        ELSE brand 
      END,
      seller = CASE 
        WHEN seller ILIKE $9 OR seller ILIKE $10
        THEN $11
        ELSE seller 
      END
    WHERE description ILIKE $12 
       OR description ILIKE $13
       OR brand ILIKE $14
       OR seller ILIKE $15
VACUUM (ANALYZE) public.products

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  field_id UUID REFERENCES shop_fields(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE pulse_posts (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  author_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title         TEXT NOT NULL,
  body          TEXT NOT NULL,
  category      TEXT,
  source_url    TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
)

CREATE TABLE commodity_listings (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  commodity_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES commodities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity      NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
  asking_price  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
  location      TEXT,
  description   TEXT,
  image_urls    TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
  status        listing_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
)
DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = ANY($1) RETURNING id

CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id        UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type      TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload   JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  read_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
)

CREATE TABLE courses (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title         TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug          TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  description   TEXT,
  instructor_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  level         TEXT DEFAULT 'beginner',
  price         NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
)

CREATE TABLE show_likes (
  id        UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  post_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES show_posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE(post_id, user_id)
)
